bio: Located on an arm of the River Rhône, this popular, bustling eatery, decked out in a profusion of nostalgic paraphernalia, calls to mind a vintage picture postcard and also boasts a wisteria-covered terrace. Fine ingredients are consummately and delicately crafted into delicious dishes, examples of which are the flawlessly cooked Black Angus steak or raspberry tartlet with a refreshing raspberry sorbet....
